exact.Novinky v 1.13: 3D animace techniky ve V: New in 1.13: 3D technique animations in Videos – dog and handler on real obstacles (jump, tunnel, weave poles, A-frame, dog walk, seesaw, tyre, long jump) and in handling (front cross, rear cross, blind, wraps, backside, start). The animation downloads only when you open a topic, simplifies itself on slower phones, and without 3D support the 2D animation stays.
exact.Novinky v 1.12: nová úvodní obrazovka Do: New in 1.12: a new Home screen – training-day streak, courses run, average speed and share of clean runs, a Continue button for the course in progress, Courses for you by the dog's class, a Daily challenge and an overview of this week's training. Course of the week: one course per class every week; submit your result to the leaderboard and compare with others by dog size.
exact.Novinky v 1.11: aplikace se aktualizuje: New in 1.11: the app updates right away and offers Reload when a new version is ready. STOP on the stopwatch is further from Split times, bigger buttons for the thumb (fault counters, obstacles on the field, dog side L/R), courses two side by side even on a small phone, the field doesn't jump when tapping the route, the keyboard doesn't cover buttons. The FCI check counts the tyre and long jump as jumps, allows at most 5 tunnel passes, and SCT and MCT come from the shown course length.
exact.Novinky v 1.10: tlačítko Zpět (↶ vedle S: New in 1.10: an Undo button (↶ next to Build / Route, Ctrl+Z on a computer) undoes moving, rotating and deleting obstacles and route changes. The screen stays on while the stopwatch runs. Dragging obstacles is smoother. Manual time can also be entered as 1:05.30. Reading a course map from a photo no longer freezes the phone and the compass in Build on the field also works on iPhone. The PDF build plan fits a square field too. A course from a code is checked before saving, so damaged data no longer crashes the app. Restoring a backup replaces all data, and if it fails nothing changes. When storage is full the app warns that a change wasn't saved. With a weak signal at the training ground the app opens within 3 seconds from the saved version and the font works offline.
